episodes.title: A Beating Heart…
episodes.summary: Dexter Morgan awakens from a ten-week coma. As he begins a painful recovery and learns Harrison has fled to NYC, both father and son are drawn closer to confronting the darkness they've tried to escape.

episodes.title: Camera Shy
episodes.summary: Dexter embeds himself in New York's ride-share community to track down a serial killer. Meanwhile, Harrison spirals from the guilt of a violent outburst.

episodes.title: Backseat Driver
episodes.summary: As Dexter sets his sights on tracking down a serial killer, he must carefully balance Blessing Kamara's attempts to help get him acclimated to the ride-share driver lifestyle. Meanwhile, Harrison is drawn deeper into the police investigation.

episodes.title: Call Me Red
episodes.summary: Dexter attends a mysterious gathering, hosted by a highly influential figure with macabre ambitions. Harrison continues to struggle with mounting guilt and pressure at work, just as Angel Batista arrives in New York City.

episodes.title: Murder Horny
episodes.summary: An encounter pushes Harrison further into his own darkness, escalating his fear of arrest. Meanwhile, as Batista closes in, Dexter pursues a dangerous connection with a seductive killer, believing they operate under a similar code.

episodes.title: Cats & Mouse
episodes.summary: As Dexter closes in on a murderer, Harrison faces a crisis of identity.

episodes.title: Course Correction
episodes.summary: Dexter, at a remote retreat, discovers unsettling information about Gareth. Meanwhile, Harrison contemplates his future.

episodes.title: The Kill Room Where It Happens
episodes.summary: Dexter redirects his attention as a way to step up as a father.

episodes.title: Touched By An Ángel
episodes.summary: Prater and Charley's revelation forces Dexter to go to extreme lengths.

episodes.title: And Justice For All...
episodes.summary: Dexter and Harrison face the consequences of their darkness. Season finale.
